repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `45151aec2b984b73f61ef2eafd2dbf018d7f3796` · 2026-11-25T03:47Z

L1 for card #37174 (p0: the studioAddress.guard timeout ejected two independent queue groups, anchor #37181). The seat dispatched it; the dev report is 7152099725.

- **Shape.** One file, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioAddress.guard.test.ts` (+98 −10). Test-only, `skip-changeset`, draft. The `Fixes #37174` line closes only this card.
- **Fix.**
  - A raw-text gate, `maySpellStudioAddress`, decides which files reach the TypeScript parse. At this head it lets 123 of 2,378 ui sources through.
  - The walk case drops from 4,471 ms to 873 ms (measured locally) and carries an explicit `{ timeout: 60_000 }` as a second line of defence.
- **Premise corrected and covered.**
  - The card's two-word filter (`/studio`, `STUDIO_ROOT_PATH`) was not an exact superset of the matcher. The matcher also reads `STUDIO_LANDING_PATH` and cooked text: `\x2f`, `/`, `\u{…}`, legacy octal and line continuations all cook to the same text.
  - The gate matches each word in every spelling that cooks back to it.
  - One `FLAGGED_SPELLINGS` list (the 8 original spellings plus 10 escaped and LANDING forms) drives both the matcher case and a new control.
- **The control closes the hole an ablation shows.**
  - With the gate returning `false`, the walk case stays green but the new control goes red.
  - With the card's two-word filter, the control goes red on `'\x2Fstudio'`.
  - Both restores were verified (blob == HEAD).
- **Gates.**
  - `dispatch-gates` derived 27 commands and all 27 exit 0. The `ui/scripts` vitest needed a spec build first.
  - The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite: 2,442 files and 23,116 tests pass.
  - `overlap-check` is clean.
  - K = 9.
- **Deviations accepted.**
  - The empty-branch probe push was refused by the classifier and not retried by another route.
  - The package suite ran after the body was written; the report carries the reading.
  - The commit trailer was fixed to the model-free pair before the first push.
- **Landing.** Tier S, test-only and not governed, so the seat lands it once every check is green: at this head, 38 success, 18 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending, mergeable clean. After merge it unblocks #37114 (a4-C), #37184 and the re-queue of the PRs this timeout ejected. #37181 closes with #37174.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
